sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Artwork viewer: H (or the Flip button) mirrors the image left-right, V upside-down — handy for a scan of a CD's mould/matrix area taken through the disc, whose matrix numbers read backwards. The mirror is as seen on screen, also on a turned image, and R keeps turning clockwise on a mirrored one. View only: nothing is changed in the archive, and the next image starts unflipped.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Viewer transform order is now translate() scaleX/scaleY() rotate() scale(): the flips act on screen, after the rotation; _artViewerRotate() reverses the turn applied underneath while exactly one flip is on; _artViewerFlip(); the flips reset with the rotation in _artViewerResetZoomOnStep(). Spec tests/fixtures/art-viewer-flip.spec.js (measure() now also reports where the image's own top-left pixel is, cornerOf()); mutation list scripts/mutations/art-viewer-flip.json.
